snapshot.text: Free public health care alongside a growing private sector and medical tourism ambitions. The government wants Mauritius to become a healthcare hub for Africa, and the balance between private care and health insurance is under debate.

priorities.title: Chikungunya and leptospirosis
priorities.text: The health minister urged action against chikungunya and leptospirosis.

priorities.title: Inclusive cancer care
priorities.text: The minister advocates inclusive cancer care.
